correctness.rationale: For any nontrivial additive character, sums of psi(ct) vanish at c nonzero even over extensions. Distinct h shifts reduce to a planar B; expanding the squared correlation by differences yields q from zero lag and zero from each nonzero lag. Thus the q bases and the coordinate basis form a complete MUB. Their centered projector spans are mutually orthogonal, each of dimension q-1, with the coordinate traceless diagonals exactly the omitted subspace. Consequently equality of data is exactly equality of norm and off-diagonal products. One nonzero off-diagonal pair identifies a two-point support if it is the sole unordered pair; the norm and product give the two roots for squared magnitudes, with phases fixed relatively. On at least three sites the three-product ratio recovers each squared magnitude, and vanishing off-diagonals leaves impulses (or zero). The extra probe sees each nontrivial lifted difference as a nonzero multiple of one squared-weight difference, so distinct weights are necessary and sufficient and add one real rank direction. Sorted unit squared weights satisfy z_j >= j delta for minimum separation delta, including the trivial delta=0 case; equality gives exactly the proposed optimizer, which is valid even with one zero coordinate.
residual_risks: The finite checks use the cubic and do not prove the universal theorem; the general proof uses planarity. Impulse contrast does not establish global stability or linear informational completeness.

originality.rationale: The claimed sharp one-intensity repair and lifting rank are mechanically implied by prior complete-MUB linear inversion and the prior rank-two criterion, applied to the known Alltop MUB completion. This is actual implication, not a keyword match: subtracting the prior inversion formula for two normalized states with the same measured q bases leaves precisely a traceless diagonal difference in the omitted basis. Passing from this known subspace to the repair is just excluding a zero coefficient on each diagonal difference e_i e_i^* - e_j e_j^*. I did not find the full list of fiber sizes and the squared-weight optimizer printed together; that does not restore the claimed distinctness of the central repair theorem. The result is mathematically true.
residual_risks: Exact bibliographic duplicates of the entire package may exist; none is asserted here. The verdict credits the demonstrated prior implication rather than relying on an irrelevant general search result or alleging that every auxiliary formula was printed before.

value.rationale: The design motivation (reuse measured chirp bases with little extra acquisition) is sensible, but the claimed contribution does not add a structural phase-retrieval result once the prior omitted-basis reconstruction and rank-two criterion are accounted for. The fiber list just enumerates rank-one factorizations with given off-diagonal entries and trace; its only nontrivial support case reduces to swapping two roots of a quadratic. The remaining optimum is equally spaced weights on a scalar simplex and controls only basis-impulse discrimination, not a stability property of the recovery problem. No valuable distinct remainder has been established by recombining those elementary consequences under the Alltop name.
residual_risks: This assessment does not deny the utility of the probe as practical advice for an already installed system; it concerns the mathematical increment claimed here. No stronger stability or measurement-efficiency theorem was supplied.
